title: PIXEL EFFECTS AND MEDALLIONS
why: The pixel cast needs square fight particles, stepped blast and ground stamps, whole-pixel rings and baked power-up medallions at the approved half size.
now: Sparks, blood, smoke and blasts use art pixels. Power-up coins are cached on the sharp HUD canvas.
